#clustering epitopes 3D
```{r}
library(igraph)

distance_cutoff <- 6 #angstrom

for (structure_index in na.omit(sort(unique(data_predictions_with_variability$structure)))[4]) {
  data_subset <- data_predictions_with_variability %>% 
    filter(structure == structure_index)
  
  protein_name <- data_subset %>% 
    pull(protein) %>%
    unique()
  
  chain_subset <- data_subset %>%
    drop_na(chain) %>%
    pull(chain) %>%
    unique()
  
  message("Processing ", protein_name, " (", structure_index, ")")
  
  pdb_object <- read.pdb.custom(pdb_entry = structure_index, pdb_path = pdbs_path)
  
  #Distance Matrix
  heavy_atoms_dm <- dm(
    pdb_object, 
    inds = atom.select(pdb_object, chain = chain_subset, type = "ATOM", alt = c(NA, "A")),
    grp = TRUE
  )
  
  resnos <- pdb_object$atom %>% filter(chain == chain_subset, type == "ATOM") %>% pull(resno) %>% unique()
  
  rownames(heavy_atoms_dm) <- resnos
  colnames(heavy_atoms_dm) <- resnos
  
  #all residue adjacency matrix
  adj_mat <- heavy_atoms_dm < distance_cutoff
  adj_mat[is.na(adj_mat)] <- FALSE
  diag(adj_mat) <- FALSE
  
  g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj_mat, mode = "undirected")
  V(g)$name <- resnos
  
  #Surface
  surface_resno <- data_subset %>%
    filter(`RSA Shrake-Rupley` > 0.15) %>%
    pull(resno)
  
  sur_adj_mat <- heavy_atoms_dm[as.character(surface_resno), as.character(surface_resno)] < distance_cutoff
  sur_adj_mat[is.na(sur_adj_mat)] <- FALSE
  diag(sur_adj_mat) <- FALSE
  
  sur_g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(sur_adj_mat, mode = "undirected")
  V(sur_g)$name <- surface_resno
  
  # Graph clustering
  epi_g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(epi_adj_mat)
  
  #Extract epitopes
  dt3_epitopes_resno <- data_subset %>%
    filter(`DiscoTope-3.0_calibrated_score` > 1.5) %>%
    pull(resno)
  
  if (length(dt3_epitopes_resno) < 2) next
  
  epi_adj_mat <- heavy_atoms_dm[as.character(dt3_epitopes_resno), as.character(dt3_epitopes_resno)] < distance_cutoff
  epi_adj_mat[is.na(epi_adj_mat)] <- FALSE
  diag(epi_adj_mat) <- FALSE
  
  # Graph clustering
  epi_g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(epi_adj_mat)
  clusters <- components(epi_g)
  
    # --- Color nodes in the general graph ---
  V(sur_g)$color <- "grey80"  # default for non-epitope residues
  
  n_clusters <- length(unique(clusters$membership))
  cluster_colors <- rainbow(n_clusters) 
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_clusters)) {
    cluster_resnos <- dt3_epitopes_resno[clusters$membership == i]
    V(sur_g)$color[match(cluster_resnos, V(sur_g)$name)] <- cluster_colors[i]
  }
  
  # --- Plot the residue contact graph ---
  plot(
    sur_g,
    vertex.label = NA,
    vertex.size = 6,
    edge.color = "grey85",
    layout = layout_with_fr(sur_g)
  )
  
  view <- NGLVieweR(paste0(pdbs_path,structure_index,".pdb")) %>%
    stageParameters(backgroundColor = "white") %>%
    addRepresentation(type = "cartoon",
                        param = list(name = "base", 
                                     colorScheme = "uniform",
                                     sele = paste0("/0 AND :",
                                                   chain_subset
                                                   )
                                     )
    )
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_clusters)) {
    view <- view %>%
      addRepresentation("surface",
                 param = list(
                   name = paste0("sel_epi", i),
                   sele = paste0(
                     "/0 AND :",
                     chain_subset,
                     " AND (",
                     paste(dt3_epitopes_resno[clusters$membership == i], collapse = " or "),
                     ")"
                   ),
                   colorValue = cluster_colors[i]
                 )
    )
  }
  
  print(view)
  
  
}
```


#clustering epitope residues into patches, statistics
```{r}
sample_connected_patch <- function(g, patch_size) {
  # pick a random starting node
  start_node <- sample(V(g)$name, 1)
  patch <- start_node
  
  while(length(patch) < patch_size) {
    # get neighbors of current patch (by vertex indices)
    patch_vertices <- V(g)[name %in% patch]
    neighbors <- unlist(ego(g, order = 1, nodes = patch_vertices, mindist = 1))
    neighbors <- V(g)[neighbors]$name
    # remove already included residues
    neighbors <- setdiff(neighbors, patch)
    if(length(neighbors) == 0) break
    # add one neighbor at random
    patch <- c(patch, sample(neighbors, 1))
  }
  
  return(patch)
}
```

```{r}
set.seed(1234)
distance_cutoff <- 6
n_permutations <- 5000
var_min <- 2
dt3_min <- 1.5 
sur_min <- 0.15

results_list <- list()

# Binary classification: variable if var_counts > var_min
for (structure_index in na.omit(sort(unique(data_predictions_with_variability$structure)))) {

  data_subset <- data_predictions_with_variability %>% 
    filter(structure == structure_index) %>%
    mutate(is_var = var_counts > var_min)
  
  protein_name <- unique(data_subset$protein)
  chain_subset <- data_subset %>% drop_na(chain) %>% pull(chain) %>% unique()
  
  message("Processing ", protein_name, " (", structure_index, ")")
  
  ifelse(!is.na(unique(data_subset$PDB)), 
         pdb_object <- read.pdb.custom(pdb_entry = structure_index, pdb_path = pdbs_path),
         pdb_object <- read.pdb.custom(pdb_entry = structure_index, pdb_path = AF3_pdbs_path)
         )
  
  resnos <- unique(pdb_object$atom$resno[pdb_object$atom$chain == chain_subset & pdb_object$atom$type == "ATOM"])
  
  heavy_atoms_dm <- dm(
    pdb_object,
    inds = atom.select(pdb_object, chain = chain_subset, type = "ATOM", alt = c(NA, "A")),
    grp = TRUE
  )
  rownames(heavy_atoms_dm) <- resnos
  colnames(heavy_atoms_dm) <- resnos
  
  # Surface residues
  surface_resno <- data_subset %>%
    filter(
      `RSA Shrake-Rupley` > sur_min,
      !is.na(var_counts) #mask histags
    ) %>%
    pull(resno)
  
  sur_adj_mat <- heavy_atoms_dm[as.character(surface_resno), as.character(surface_resno)] < distance_cutoff
  sur_adj_mat[is.na(sur_adj_mat)] <- FALSE
  diag(sur_adj_mat) <- FALSE
  
  sur_g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(sur_adj_mat, mode = "undirected")
  V(sur_g)$name <- surface_resno
  
  # Extract epitope residues
  dt3_epitopes_resno <- data_subset %>%
    filter(`DiscoTope-3.0_calibrated_score` > dt3_min) %>%
    pull(resno)
  
  dt3_epitopes_resno <- intersect(dt3_epitopes_resno, surface_resno)
  if (length(dt3_epitopes_resno) < 2) next
  
  # Epitope adjacency and clustering
  epi_adj_mat <- heavy_atoms_dm[as.character(dt3_epitopes_resno), as.character(dt3_epitopes_resno)] < distance_cutoff
  diag(epi_adj_mat) <- FALSE
  epi_adj_mat[is.na(epi_adj_mat)] <- FALSE
  
  epi_g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(epi_adj_mat, mode = "undirected")
  clusters <- components(epi_g)
  
  # --- Order clusters by size (largest first) ---
  cluster_sizes <- table(clusters$membership)
  cluster_order <- as.numeric(names(sort(cluster_sizes, decreasing = TRUE)))
  
  # Reassign cluster labels by descending size
  ordered_membership <- match(clusters$membership, cluster_order)
  
  # Compute observed density per ordered cluster
  observed_density <- map_dbl(seq_len(length(cluster_order)), function(i) {
    res_in_cluster <- dt3_epitopes_resno[ordered_membership == i]
    mean(data_subset$is_var[data_subset$resno %in% res_in_cluster], na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  
  # Permutation test with connected patches
  permuted_density <- map(seq_len(length(cluster_order)), function(i) {
    cluster_size <- sum(ordered_membership == i)
    replicate(n_permutations, {
      sampled_patch <- sample_connected_patch(sur_g, cluster_size)
      mean(data_subset$is_var[data_subset$resno %in% sampled_patch], na.rm = TRUE)
    })
  })
  
  # --- Assemble tibble with proper ordering ---
  results_list[[structure_index]] <- tibble(
    structure = structure_index,
    protein = protein_name,
    chain = chain_subset,
    epitope_id = seq_len(length(cluster_order)),
    epitope_size = as.numeric(cluster_sizes[cluster_order]),
    epitope_residues = map(seq_len(length(cluster_order)), function(i) {
      res_in_cluster <- dt3_epitopes_resno[ordered_membership == i]
      paste0(
        "[", data_subset$resid[data_subset$resno %in% res_in_cluster], "]",
        res_in_cluster, ":", chain_subset
      )
    }),
    observed_density = observed_density,
    permuted_density = permuted_density,
    mean_perm_density = map_dbl(permuted_density, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_perm_density = map_dbl(permuted_density, ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      # Z-score for reference
      z_score = (observed_density - mean_perm_density) / sd_perm_density,
      
      # One-tailed (epitopes more variable than expected)
      p_one_tailed = map2_dbl(observed_density, permuted_density, function(obs, perm) {
                              (1 + sum(obs >= perm, na.rm = TRUE)) / (1 + length(perm))
        }),
      
      # Two-tailed (epitopes differ from expected — could be more OR less variable)
      p_two_tailed = map2_dbl(observed_density, permuted_density, function(obs, perm) {
        mean_perm <- mean(perm, na.rm = TRUE)
        (1 + sum(abs(perm - mean_perm) >= abs(obs - mean_perm), na.rm = TRUE)) / (1 + length(perm))
      }),
      
      # Adjusted p-values (FDR)
      p_one_tailed_adj = p.adjust(p_one_tailed, method = "fdr"),
      p_two_tailed_adj = p.adjust(p_two_tailed, method = "fdr")
    )
}

```

plots_list <- results_list %>%

        geom_point() +
        #geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "blue") +

        labs(
          x = "Epitope Size",
          y = "One-tailed p-value",
          title = "Epitope Size vs. p-value"
        ))

results_list %>% imap_dfr(~ mutate(.x, protein = .y)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x= epitope_size, y=1-p_one_tailed)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1-0.05) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Epitope Size",
    y = "1 - p-value",
    title = "Epitope Size vs. p-value"
  )
